name: Priscilla
title: Tentmaker and Teacher
summary: Priscilla (Prisca) was a Jewish-Christian woman married to Aquila. They were tentmakers with whom Paul lived and worked in Corinth. They followed Paul to Ephesus, where they instructed Apollos in the faith. Priscilla is often mentioned before her husband, suggesting her prominent role in the church.

keyEvents.title: Meeting with Paul
keyEvents.description: Priscilla and Aquila welcomed Paul in Corinth after being expelled from Rome.

keyEvents.title: Instructed Apollos
keyEvents.description: When Apollos was preaching in Ephesus, they took him aside and explained the way of God more accurately.

keyEvents.title: Church in the Home
keyEvents.description: Priscilla and Aquila held church gatherings in their home.
